suggested_fix.fix_text: The agent stopped investigating 'Kingdom of Rock' after Turn 6 due to ambiguity, but resumed an old search strategy (adding '2007') in Turn 7 and repeated the exact same query in Turns 7, 9, and 11 without incorporating the new AllMusic hint from Turn 12 or exploring the specific artist 'Graham Elks' mentioned in Turn 12.

probe_details.notes: The error type 'step_repetition' is only partially correct. The agent did not repeat the EXACT same query across Turns 0-4 as claimed (it searched 'Was I the Wave?' first). The actual error is 'search_stagnation' or 'hallucinated_context': The agent abandoned a productive lead (Ambiguity in Turn 6) and got stuck looping on a specific unverified hypothesis ('2007' search) in Turns 7, 9, and 11. Crucially, after Turn 12 explicitly mentioned a new result (AllMusic list) and Turn 13 showed the agent loading that page, the Planner (Turn 14) correctly noted the page was updating, yet the WebSurfer (Turn 15) immediately re-typed the SAME URL that just failed, ignoring the potential to wait or try another source. The analysis incorrectly attributes the loop to Turns 0-4 where queries were actually different; the loop occurs in Turns 7, 9, 11 and 13-15.
